en.headline: Ryan Choi takes Asian Games men's foil silver
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer fell 15-13 to Japan's Kazuki Iimura in the final at Tokoname, securing the city's first fencing medal of the Games after a late fightback.
body: Hong Kong fencer Ryan Choi Chun-yin claimed silver in the men's individual foil at the Asian Games on Tuesday night, losing 15-13 to Japan's Kazuki Iimura in a tense final at the Aichi International Exhibition Center in Tokoname.

Iimura opened a substantial lead and led 10-5 before Choi staged a comeback, drawing level at 12-12 and briefly moving ahead 13-12. The Japanese fencer then scored the decisive touches to take gold. Choi had advanced with wins over opponents from Kazakhstan, Singapore and South Korea after receiving a bye in the round of 32.

The result is Hong Kong's first fencing medal at these Games. Choi said the medal belonged to everyone who supported him and expressed hope of winning gold with teammates in the team event. Olympic champion Cheung Ka-long had exited earlier in the round of 32.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍摘銀 港隊今屆首面劍擊獎牌
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥在常滑決賽以13比15不敵日本劍手飯村一輝，逆轉後仍差一步奪金，為港隊贏得今屆亞運首面劍擊獎牌。
body: 香港劍手蔡俊彥周二晚在亞運男子個人花劍決賽以13比15不敵日本的飯村一輝，奪得銀牌，這是港隊今屆亞運首面劍擊獎牌。
賽事於常滑愛知國際展覽中心舉行。飯村早段領先至10比5，蔡俊彥其後追至12平，一度領先13比12，惟最後階段被對手反超奪金。蔡俊彥早前輪空後先後擊敗哈薩克、新加坡及南韓對手晉級決賽。
蔡俊彥表示獎牌屬於所有支持他的人，並希望在團體賽與隊友再奪金牌。奧運金牌得主張家朗早前已於32強出局。
